caribbean.headline: Antigua Faces Rough Seas and Heavy Rain
caribbean.paragraph: Antigua is experiencing sustained east-northeast winds near 24 kt with seas to 11.8 ft, an ENE swell at a 9 s period, and a 75% rain probability. I expect Small Craft Advisory conditions for Antigua approaches and advise caution for Roatan, where winds up to 25 kt and choppy seas will hamper small-boat and ferry operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Sees 26 kt Winds, Seas Top 7 ft
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing WNW winds sustained at 26 kt with seas to 7.1 ft and a dominant WNW swell of 7 s period; less than 10% rain probability. I consider these conditions to meet Small Craft Advisory criteria for the Mykonos approaches and recommend caution for small vessels, while Dubrovnik remains much lighter with winds near 12 kt and lower seas.
